* Claude
* ChatGPT
* Grok
* Manus
* Higgsfield and Seedance

* AI image\-generation tools

Prior professional experience with these tools is helpful but **not required**. If you are comfortable learning new technology quickly, we encourage you to apply.

* Spend a lot of time using or understanding social media
* Know how TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, Xiaohongshu, or similar platforms work
* Enjoy creating short videos, posts, advertisements, or other online content
* Are interested in AI and automation
* Can learn new AI applications quickly
* Understand what makes online content interesting and engaging

**$20\.00 per hour**

Casual / Part\-time hours with a potentially flexible schedule.

Location

**Berkeley and or 1900 Powell St Emeryville, California**

title: Operations Manager
description:
**The Company**

DRINKSTATION is a **hardware technology startup** that designs, manufactures, and sells the most advanced beverage dispensing appliances on the market. Our flagship system, the **Da Vinci 2\.0**, delivers purified, sparkling, chilled, and near\-boiling water on demand — replacing the filter, kettle, sparkling\-water maker, and pitcher with one integrated appliance. Our **Model\-J** pushes the platform further into **multi\-beverage dispensing and flavored water**, serving a range of customizable beverages on demand from a single connected machine.

Founded in Los Angeles in 2014 on more than two decades of water\-dispensing R\&D, we now operate across three countries: our **U.S. headquarters in Torrance, CA**, our **engineering and manufacturing facility in Shenzhen, China**, and our **R\&D and patent center in Pisa, Italy**. With 80\+ team members, **100\+ patents**, decades of combined experience, and an ambitious product roadmap, we're scaling fast — and we need an operator who can keep the whole machine running as we grow.

**The Role**

We're hiring an **Operations Manager** to sit at the center of our business and keep every moving part in sync. This is a broad, high\-ownership role for someone who can help build out our **National Service Center** for appliances, manage logistics, lead a team of technicians and engineers, support clients, and drive new projects from idea to execution.

You'll work directly with leadership and across our global teams. This is a role with real runway: strong performers can grow into a **General Manager or Chief Operating Officer** position as the company expands.

**What You'll Do**

**Logistics \& Supply Chain**

* Own logistics and shipping coordination end to end — container scheduling, freight, customs, and inbound/outbound movement between our China facility and U.S. operations
* Manage product prep, staging, and fulfillment so units are ready when clients need them
* Direct and troubleshoot the supply chain, anticipating bottlenecks before they become problems

**Client Support**

* Serve as a trusted point of contact for clients and partners, resolving issues quickly and professionally by assisting with troubleshooting appliances in the field
* Coordinate with technicians and engineers to ensure technical and service issues are resolved and avoided in the future

**Team Leadership**

* Manage and support our technicians, engineers, and warehouse personnel — setting priorities, removing blockers, and keeping projects on schedule
* Build a culture of accountability, craftsmanship, and follow\-through

**New Projects \& Initiatives**

* Lead new projects across operations, product, and process — scoping, planning, and driving them to completion
* Identify opportunities to make the business run better, faster, and more efficiently as we scale

**Hiring \& Growth**

* Assist with recruiting, interviewing, and onboarding as we build out the team

**What We're Looking For**

**Required**

* Experience in **logistics management and shipping coordination / supply chain** — you understand how goods move and how to keep them moving
* Proven experience **leading teams and managing groups** of people
* **Proficiency in effectively prompting and using Claude / ChatGPT AI** to work faster and smarter — this is a core part of how we operate
* Excellent **communication skills** and strong organization, with sharp attention to detail
* A hungry, hands\-on, **get\-it\-done mindset** — comfortable owning outcomes in a fast\-moving startup
* In order to confirm you've read this description, please go to our website at drinkstation.com and mention one piece of info about our company that stood out to you.

**Preferred / Welcomed**

* Background in **operations, engineering, or business administration, with programming knowledge a big plus**
* **Kitchen appliance** industry experience
* **E\-commerce / consumer packaged goods (CPG)** experience
* **Chinese language proficiency** — a major plus for coordinating directly with our Shenzhen engineering and manufacturing team
* **Bachelor's degree** in Business Administration, Operations, Engineering, or a related field

**Compensation \& Growth**

* **Starting salary: $100,000–$130,000**, based on experience
* Clear path to grow into a **General Manager or COO** role as the company scales
* The chance to help build a category\-defining brand in premium beverage technology, working across a global, three\-country operation

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: $100,000\.00 \- $130,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Health insurance

Education:

* Bachelor's (Required)

Ability to Commute:

* Torrance, CA 90501 (Required)

title: Software Engineer, Robotics Tracking and Fusion
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI\-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting\-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

### **ABOUT THE TEAM**



At Anduril, our Software Engineers specialize in solving complex, real\-world problems through cutting\-edge algorithms and intelligent software integrations. Operating in small, innovative teams, we push the boundaries of what's possible to deliver advanced technologies with mission\-critical applications. Our commitment doesn't end with academic research or proof\-of\-concept experiments; we measure our success by the real\-world impact of our deployed solutions. Inspired by Arthur C. Clarke's vision — "Any sufficiently advanced technology is indistinguishable from magic" — we aim to achieve groundbreaking results in target tracking, state estimation, and situational awareness. We are currently seeking highly talented technologists to join our mission and redefine the future of defense technology.


#### **WHAT YOU WILL DO:**


* Define and influence the direction of a small team, leveraging your subject\-matter expertise in target tracking and state estimation.
* Prototype and deploy state\-of\-the\-art algorithms for tracking, multi\-sensor data fusion, and state estimation in agile, iterative development environments.
* Develop high\-performance software for real\-time systems, ranging from tactical implementations to simulation environments and decision support tools.
* Design and implement robust filters, estimators, and probabilistic reasoning systems that enable actionable insights from noisy, ambiguous, or incomplete sensor data.
* Analyze system performance using high\-fidelity simulations, innovative modeling tools, and rigorous statistical techniques to validate the benefits of our technology.
* Drive customer success by customizing algorithms and software for mission\-critical use cases, including real\-time tracking and sensor fusion.
* Integrate tracking and estimation technologies into the broader software development lifecycle, from requirements definition through testing and optimization.
* Translate technical progress into clear, actionable insights for diverse stakeholders, including colleagues and end\-users.

#### **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**


* Proficiency in algorithm design, software development, and statistical modeling with programming expertise in C/C\+\+, Python, and Matlab.
* Strong knowledge of target tracking techniques, such as Kalman filters, particle filters, and multi\-target tracking algorithms (e.g., JPDA, MHT, or PHD filters).
* Experience in state estimation, including Bayesian filtering, sensor fusion, and recursive estimation techniques.
* Solid understanding of applied mathematics, including linear algebra, optimization, probability, and stochastic processes.
* Knowledge of signal processing techniques for interpreting diverse sensor data (e.g., radar, lidar, EO/IR).
* Familiarity with big data pipelines, NoSQL databases, and the efficient handling of large\-scale sensor data.
* Background in machine learning as applied to target tracking and recognition, including clustering, classification, and anomaly detection techniques.
* Ability to engineer robust systems for estimation theory, adaptive filtering, controls, and complex signal environments.
* Demonstrated ability to work across development lifecycles, from prototyping to optimizing production systems.
* Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Top Secret security clearance.


*We request transcripts as part of the early application process to understand your academic background and how your coursework supports the skills deemed critical for the role. Transcripts help us assess your technical and analytical abilities, complementing our interview process in which we also evaluate practical experience and cultural fit. If you choose not to share your transcripts, you will need to provide detailed information regarding your academic performance in relevant courses, including projects and coursework specifics, to ensure we evaluate your academic accomplishments properly. If you do provide academic transcripts, feel free to redact non\-technical information (e.g., student ID, dates, non\-technical coursework, etc.). Unofficial transcripts obtained online acceptable for this assessment.*


The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top\-tier benefits for full\-time employees, including:

  


### **Benefits**



At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you're supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. *For more information,* *Explore Our Benefits**.*

  



### **Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams**



Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.



To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:


* **No Financial Requests:** Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.
* **Please always verify communications:**
	+ Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will *only* come from an @anduril.com address.
	+ Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.
* **Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach:** If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.
* **What to Do If You Suspect Fraud:** Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.
  


### **Data Privacy**



To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant\-privacy\-notice/.

  



By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third\-party service provider to conduct pre\-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third\-party service provider provides risk\-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public\-record information, and other lawful open\-source or commercial data sources. This third\-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

title: Vice President of Quality & Regulatory
description:
**About LightForce**
====================



LightForce is leading the digital transformation of orthodontics. Our fully digital, 3D\-printed platform replaces traditional stock brackets with fully customized, patient\-specific brackets paired with AI\-driven treatment planning — giving orthodontists more predictable outcomes and patients a better experience. We're pushing the boundaries of what's possible in personalized care, and we're just getting started. Learn more at www.lf.co.


**The Opportunity**
===================



LightForce is looking for a VP of Quality \& Regulatory to build the organization, systems, and culture that will carry us through our next stage of commercial scale. You'll inherit a Quality function that has successfully supported product development and early commercialization — and you'll be the one who takes it to the next level.



This isn't a gatekeeper role. You'll build rigorous, scalable systems that let LightForce move fast precisely because quality and regulatory thinking are built in from the start, not bolted on at the end. You will participate on the Executive Leadership Team as the company's senior voice on product quality, patient safety, and regulatory strategy — with real influence over how we build, not just whether we ship.


**What You'll Do**
==================


**Own the Quality Management System**


* Strengthen and scale the LightForce QMS in line with FDA requirements, ISO 13485, and other applicable global standards — practical and rigorous, not bureaucratic.
* Establish sustained audit and inspection readiness and management reviews that actually drive decisions.


**Lead Process Quality**


* Build a strong process quality capability with Operations — process control, SPC, validation (IQ/OQ/PQ), and quality\-at\-the\-source practices.
* Use data and trend analysis to catch emerging issues before they become systemic, driving the shift from inspection toward prevention.


**Drive Root\-Cause Discipline**


* Own the effectiveness of the nonconformance and CAPA systems, with rigorous root\-cause investigation and closed\-loop learning back into design, process, and training.


**Champion Design \& Software Quality**


* Partner with Product, Hardware, Software, and Clinical throughout development — not just at release — on design controls, DHFs, verification/validation, and risk management.


**Own Regulatory Strategy \& Execution**


* Set LightForce's global regulatory strategy, lead submissions and filings, and serve as senior company representative with FDA, Notified Bodies, and other authorities.


**Build the Organization**


* Recruit and develop leaders and specialists across Quality Engineering, Regulatory, Supplier Quality, and Complaints/CAPA, with real succession depth.
* Build an executive quality dashboard, and report performance and risk to the ELT and Board.

**What You Bring**
==================


* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Life Sciences, or a related technical field.
* 12\+ years of progressive quality leadership in regulated medical devices, including significant commercial\-manufacturing quality responsibility, with at least 5 years leading a substantial Quality organization or major function.
* Deep knowledge of FDA medical\-device requirements, ISO 13485, design controls, risk management, CAPA, process validation, and supplier quality.
* A track record leading FDA, Notified Body, and other regulatory interactions and audits, and developing regulatory strategies and submissions for commercial devices.
* Demonstrated use of quality engineering and statistical methods to prevent problems, not just catch them.

**Who Thrives Here**
====================



We're looking for someone who has seen this scaling journey before — who knows how a Quality and Regulatory organization needs to evolve as a medtech company moves from early commercialization into real scale. You hold an independent quality voice with the confidence to challenge senior leaders when it matters, but you're pragmatic and solutions\-oriented, not bureaucratic — you understand that strong quality systems should create speed and confidence, not slow everyone down. You're technical enough to go deep, but you can explain complex quality and regulatory issues simply to executives, engineers, and the Board alike. You build systems and people rather than becoming the bottleneck yourself, and you're comfortable with ambiguity, incomplete information, and ambitious goals.


**Compensation \& Perks**
=========================


* Unlimited PTO for exempt employees (accrued PTO for non\-exempt employees, up to 15 days)
* 12 paid holidays per year, plus 3 paid volunteer days
* Generous premium coverage for medical, dental, and vision
* 401(k) retirement plan and paid parental leave
* Fringe lifestyle benefit, plus everyday perks like snacks and coffee in office

**Part I — About Excel Education Systems**

Excel Education Systems is a nationally accredited education technology organization serving K–12, adult education, higher education, and workforce development. We operate accredited online schools and an accredited career college while developing proprietary technology that supports students, educators, administrators, and institutional leaders.

Our technology ecosystem includes Learn Stage® Learning Management System and Student Information System, BRYTE™ AI Learning Assistant, and ExcelHQ® Enterprise Management Platform. The next chapter is not a ground\-up rebuild; it is the disciplined evolution of a functioning ecosystem into a next\-generation, AI\-powered learning and management platform.

**The Opportunity**

Excel Education Systems seeks a hands\-on, AI\-first Chief Technology Officer to lead technology strategy, product evolution, architecture, engineering standards, and the transition from offshore development to a high\-performing U.S.\-based team. The CTO will work directly with the CEO, internal technology professionals, and the Education Technology Department.

This is not a conventional executive role focused primarily on budgets, vendors, or a large engineering hierarchy. It is a player\-coach position for an accomplished technology leader who can set direction, inspect architecture, challenge technical decisions, mentor developing professionals, and use modern AI tools to multiply a small team’s output.

**Our AI\-First Development Philosophy**

We believe artificial intelligence is changing how software is conceived, built, tested, documented, secured, and improved. AI\-assisted tools should generate a substantial portion of implementation work; experienced professionals remain accountable for product judgment, architecture, validation, security, quality, and maintainability.

· Oversee SOC 2 readiness, data privacy, identity management, disaster recovery, incident preparedness, and cybersecurity coordination with external specialists.

· Create clear ownership, engineering rituals, decision rights, documentation standards, and performance expectations.

· Lead a controlled transition of Learn Stage development, maintenance, and innovation from the current offshore vendor to a U.S.\-based team without disrupting service.

· Current residence in the Minneapolis–Saint Paul metropolitan area and ability to work from Minnetonka at least three days each week.

· At least 10 years of progressively responsible software engineering experience, including at least five years leading technology teams or enterprise SaaS products.

· Improved the experience of students, educators, administrators, and internal teams.

**Position Overview**

The ideal candidate possesses deep technical engineering and integration experience, enabling them to dissect, analyze, and secure highly complex, multi\-domain systems.

Acting as a trusted technical advisor to the Authorizing Official (AO) and directly supports the CIO of the Agency. title: Exhibit Designer - Denver, CO
description:
### **Description**

  

**Exhibit Designer**  

**Location:** Denver, Colorado
**Job Type:** Full\-Time \| On\-Site  

**About IGE**
  

IGE – InterGlobal Exhibits is an experiential marketing agency specializing in designing and building trade show exhibits and branded environments worldwide. We create memorable experiences that help brands connect with their audiences through innovative design, quality craftsmanship, and exceptional service.  

**About the Role**
  

IGE is seeking a creative and detail\-oriented **Exhibit Designer** to design innovative trade show exhibits, branded environments, and experiential marketing spaces that bring our clients' brands to life.  

The Exhibit Designer works closely with Sales, Account Management, Estimating, Engineering, Graphics, and Production to transform client objectives into compelling exhibit concepts that are visually impactful, manufacturable, and aligned with project budgets and timelines.  

This role combines creativity with technical expertise and is ideal for a designer who understands both **design and fabrication** while delivering exceptional client experiences.  

**Key Responsibilities**
  

Concept Development \& Design* Develop creative concepts aligned with client goals, branding, and marketing objectives.
* Design custom trade show exhibits, rental exhibits, branded environments, and experiential displays.
* Produce presentation\-quality 3D renderings, floor plans, elevations, and concept drawings.
* Select appropriate materials, finishes, lighting, graphics, and construction methods.
* Balance creativity, functionality, budget, and manufacturability.
* Present design concepts internally and, when appropriate, directly to clients.
* Revise concepts based on feedback while maintaining design quality.
* Research industry trends, materials, technologies, and innovative exhibit solutions.

  

**Project Development*** Review project requirements, budgets, schedules, and venue regulations before beginning design.
* Partner with Account Executives and Account Managers to understand project objectives.
* Collaborate with Estimating to ensure concepts can be accurately priced.
* Work with Engineering and Production to confirm designs can be efficiently fabricated and installed.
* Maintain organized project documentation, renderings, reference materials, and design files.
* Coordinate freelance designers when assigned.

  

**Cross\-Functional Collaboration*** Participate in project kickoff meetings and design reviews.
* Collaborate with Account Executives, Account Managers, Estimators, Engineers, Graphics, and Production teams.
* Support exhibit previews and client presentations as needed.
* Create marketing renderings and visual assets to support business development initiatives.
* Maintain clear communication throughout the project lifecycle.

  

**Continuous Improvement*** Stay current on exhibit design trends, fabrication techniques, software, and emerging technologies.
* Continuously improve rendering quality and presentation standards.
* Develop innovative solutions that maximize the reuse of existing inventory when appropriate.
* Promote sustainable design practices by minimizing waste and extending the lifecycle of exhibit assets.
* Contribute ideas that improve design quality, workflow efficiency, and IGE's competitive advantage.

**Required Qualifications*** Bachelor's degree in **Industrial Design, Interior Design, Architecture, Environmental Design**, or a related discipline preferred.
* Minimum **3 years of professional experience** in exhibit design, experiential marketing, retail environments, environmental graphics, architectural design, or a related field.
* Strong portfolio demonstrating creative design thinking and high\-quality visualization skills.
* Experience taking projects from concept through fabrication.
* Understanding of exhibit construction methods, materials, fabrication processes, and installation considerations.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
* Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced, collaborative environment.

  

### **Technical Skills**

 **3D Modeling — proficiency in at least one:*** SketchUp
* FormZ
* Rhino
* Blender
* 3ds Max
* Equivalent professional 3D modeling software

**Rendering:*** Lumion preferred
* Enscape
* V\-Ray
* Twinmotion

**Additional Software:*** AutoCAD or equivalent CAD software
* Adobe Photoshop
* Adobe Illustrator
* Adobe InDesign
* Microsoft Office Suite

**Preferred Qualifications*** Familiarity with AI\-assisted visualization and design tools.
* Experience collaborating with engineering and fabrication teams.
* Knowledge of trade show regulations and venue requirements.
* Experience designing modular or reusable exhibit systems.

**What Success Looks Like**  

The successful Exhibit Designer will:* Create compelling designs that help win new business.
* Produce presentation\-quality renderings on schedule.
* Deliver projects within established budgets and deadlines.
* Design exhibits that are creative, practical, and manufacturable.
* Communicate effectively across multiple departments.
* Respond efficiently to revisions and changing project priorities.
* Maintain organized documentation throughout the design process.
* Contribute innovative ideas that elevate IGE's design standards.

  

### **Core Competencies**

  

Creativity • Design Thinking • Visual Communication • Collaboration • Problem Solving • Attention to Detail • Time Management • Customer Focus • Adaptability • Accountability • Initiative • Professionalism### **Work Environment**

  

This is a **full\-time, on\-site position based at IGE's Denver headquarters**. The role requires close daily collaboration with Sales, Account Management, Engineering, Estimating, Graphics, and Production.  

Occasional travel may be required for client meetings, exhibit installations, project previews, and industry trade shows.### **About IGE**


InterGlobal Exhibits (IGE) is a trade show exhibit house specializing in the design and fabrication of trade show exhibits, corporate events and retail installations. We are a private, family\-owned business with almost 25 years of experience in the industry. Supporting client projects domestically or overseas, we have a state\-of\-the\-art design studio, full fabrication facilities, and storage, as well as offer logistics and show services. From designing an exhibit that captures the essence of your brand, to installation and dismantle, to storage and managing your program, when you partner with IGE, you only have to do one contract.

Our corporate culture is informal and comprised of excellent talent in design, management, engineering, accounting, and manufacturing. We are a creative, detail\-oriented team, eager to impress from start to finish. We appreciate the growth that comes from a challenge and enjoy helping execute the visions of our partners. Good business is about building relationships and some of the most demanding marketing managers in the world trust us to develop rich, memorable brand experiences. The goal is simple: to help companies stand out by focusing on the details that make them distinctive.
